historicalLfs.unavailable.zh-CN: 无法在本地校验此历史 LFS 对象

historicalLfs.confirmHint.en: Download this exact historical object from the selected remote. The host verifies the fetch destination before downloading. This fills the LFS cache; it does not check out or stage the file. Preview size limits still apply.
historicalLfs.confirmHint.zh-CN: 从所选远端下载此历史对象，宿主会先校验下载目标。此操作只填充 LFS 缓存，不检出或暂存文件；预览大小限制仍然适用。

historicalLfs.noRemote.en: No remote with a verified LFS fetch destination is available.
historicalLfs.noRemote.zh-CN: 没有可用且已校验的 LFS 下载远端。

historicalLfs.failed.en: The download did not complete. Check the operation error before retrying.
historicalLfs.failed.zh-CN: 下载未完成，请检查操作错误后重试。

historicalLfs.isolated.en: Open this comparison in the main repository view to download the object.
historicalLfs.isolated.zh-CN: 请在对应仓库的主视图中打开此比较后下载对象。
